Class ClassAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.example.bluej.ClassAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
public class ClassAdapter extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
Adapter: converts BlueJ's class events into the plugin's class events. The first time a class is seen it is reported as EventType.CLASS_CREATED; after that, changes are EventType.CLASS_MODIFIED, and removal is EventType.CLASS_DELETED.
